data.name: TCG World
data.detailed_description:
TCG World is a player-driven open-world adventure built around exploration, progression, and creation. Set across a massive persistent world with diverse regions, players define their own path as they explore new areas, gather resources, capture and develop Sprites, design and build custom homes, craft items, fish, farm, race, and take part in shared experiences with others.

Every system exists within the same connected world, allowing players to move naturally between different playstyles without restriction. Exploration, building, crafting, farming, fishing, Sprite progression, and multiplayer activity all contribute to a larger sense of presence and long-term progression.

TCG World rewards players who explore further, build earlier, and establish themselves within the world. The more time invested, the more progression, customization, and opportunity players create for themselves.

Key Features:

Explore a massive persistent open world

Travel across diverse regions filled with resources, hidden areas, and opportunities to discover.

Capture and develop Sprites

Find, collect, and progress with Sprites as part of your long-term journey through the world.

Build your place in the world

Design custom homes and structures that reflect your style and progression.

Gather, craft, farm, and fish

Collect resources, craft useful items, cultivate crops, raise livestock, and fish across multiple regions.

Play in a shared online world

Explore, compete, collaborate, and take part in activities alongside other players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 4060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
